thread:
OpsBot: Alert: elevated error-rate of malformed outputs and unexpected tokenization on hosted text-gen in eu-central-1 after deploy window. Auto-incident 1820000001 created.
Leah Park: Customers reporting truncated or garbled responses, sometimes missing function-call fields. Noticing pattern after tokenizer library bump.
Diego Ramos: I see deploy at 02:15 UTC: tokenizer-lite v1.12 rolled to eu-central canary. Tokenization diffs show new splitting rules for emoticons/zero-width joiners.
Nina Patel: Rolling back tokenizer-lite to v1.11 on canary now. Command: `deploy rollback tokenizer-lite --region=eu-central --canary=true`
ModelOps Bot: Canary rollback applied to pod eu-c-07. Routing will prefer pre-upgrade model variants for 10m.
CS Ops: Sending urgent note to impacted customers (IDs redacted). Suggested message: "You may see truncated or malformed outputs in EU region; we're rolling back a tokenizer update and will follow up." Approve?
Leah Park: Approve. Add note about potential function-calling truncation for integration customers.
Diego Ramos: Canary metrics: tokenization error events down ~92% after rollback on canary. Full rollback queued for remaining pools with 30s stagger.
QoS Team: Temporarily disabling auto-preprocessing step `normalize_zwj` for eu-central as added safety. Live config: `preproc.normalize_zwj=false`
Nina Patel: Initiating full rollback to v1.11 across eu-central at 02:23 UTC; expected completion ~02:28 UTC. Monitoring for regressions.
ModelOps Bot: During rollback, incoming requests from strict-SLO customers are routed to companion pinned model that uses tokenizer v1.11. Fallback ratio ~6%.
Leah Park: CS: track any customers reporting persistent integration breakage; prepare to offer dedicated support windows.
Diego Ramos: Full rollback completed at 02:29 UTC. Post-rollback checks: malformed output events returned to baseline across 14/15 pools; one pool (eu-c-11) showing residual truncation due to cached tokens in edge proxy. Purging cache on that edge.
QoS Team: Edge cache purge executed on eu-edge-11; client repros now show correct outputs.
Nina Patel: Severity: customer visible, S3 -> S2 during peak. Mitigations: rollback, routing fallbacks, config disable.
OpsBot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1820000001 (public update pending CS review).
Leah Park: Next steps: 1) postmortem owner: Diego Ramos, 2) add tokenizer compatibility gate to deploy CI, 3) add alert for tokenization delta rate > 0.5% over baseline, 4) coordinate outbound comms.
CS Ops: Draft public status: "We experienced degraded/incorrect outputs in EU due to a tokenizer update; we have rolled back the change and service is restored for most customers. We will follow up with affected accounts." Queue for publish after Diego review. :white_check_mark:
Diego Ramos: Postmortem ETA initial draft 48hrs. Action items: stricter pre-deploy token-diff checks, canary traffic ramp controls, and edge-cache invalidation automation.
StatusBot: Final internal status: mitigated, full rollback successful, monitoring for 2h. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/tokenizer-deploy-failures
OpsBot: Alerts suppressed at 02:40 UTC; will reopen if tokenization error-rate > threshold.
Leah Park: Closing incident channel for live ops; will reopen for postmortem review.
